subject: Music Production
title: GarageBand Democratizes Music
description: Learn GarageBand Democratizes Music in one minute.

hook.text: In 2004, Apple bundled a free music production app called GarageBand with every new Mac computer.

buildup.text: GarageBand offered virtual instruments, pre-made loops, and a recording interface for beginners.

discovery.text: Millions who had never touched a studio suddenly had production tools on their laptops.

twist.text: Several artists who started on GarageBand went on to sign major record deals and win awards.

climax.text: Free software proved that talent mattered more than expensive equipment in music production.

punchline.text: A free app turned millions of laptops into studios.

quiz.question: What made GarageBand significant for music production?
options: It was the most powerful DAW available
It came free with every Mac, reaching millions
It was the first app to support MIDI
